avis.texte: This is the best water gel moisturizer, I've switched a tried many other water gel moisturizers and I always come back to this one. My skin has stayed clear since I've started using this product. It's hydrating and lightweight for under makeup. I have a combo skin type acne prone and this has fixed all those issues. I disagree with the negative reviews strongly, this product has been a great everyday moisturzier.

Not a fan of this moisturizer. I have acne prone skin and I can get a little oily. This dried my face out so bad. Felt tight and itchy. And the smell is terrible. Very perfumy. It lingers after you put it on so I would smell it for a while.

I bought this product a while back ago And wanted to try a water gel moisturizer to see what it would do for my skin. I Felt a burning irritation while using it . It has way to much fragrance in the product. I do not recommend this to anyone!!

avis.titre: Love love love !! Don't hesitate to buy.
avis.texte: I have used this product for over 6 month alone with the Murad SPF , although it does leave white flakes once rubbed in together still makes my skin feel seemingly soft after . Great to wear as a makeup primer!

I haven't had a product that healed my skin so much since I was 15 and my doctor recommended a good cleanser. Both times in my life, then and now, I've been under immense stress and my skin shows it. This has been a holy grail product for me. I was so frustrated that it had 4.1 stars here I had to leave a review lol. I have oily / combo skin that is acne prone. For reference of my skin type, some other products that work on me are La Roche Possay gel cleanser, products with sulfur, CeraVe moisturizers, etc. This product has a natural ingredient that supposedly "breaks up the communication between acne that causes more acne" or whatever it says on the box, and I think that's why it is especially curing for me. It also smells so good, like medical but expensive lol. Just try it.

avis.titre: The ONLY moisturizer that's ever worked for me
avis.texte: I'm 56. I have acne prone, slightly oily skin. Until my 50's I always had very oily skin. No matter how much money I spent, moisturizers and sunscreens left me greasy, my skin feeling smothered and broken out. This is the first moisturizer I've ever been able to use. Its so light and refreshing, I absolutely love it. I have not had a single breakout from this. My skin drinks it in. My other products work well with this and my make up goes over smoothly. Highly recommend.

i bought the product thinking it was going to be very refreshing on my face. it however didnt seem to do that at all. So much fragrance on the product and broke me out as i continued to use it. i thought maybe it was pruging however moisturers are not likely to cause purging. just was NOT worth the price bcs it did absolutely nothing for my skin but irritate it. i have combo skin and expected so much more from this product.

I love this moisturizer! I use it before applying makeup. I love that it absorbs quickly and feels great on my skin. I have noticed my skin is a lot clearer since using this product and it makes my makeup go on smoother and look better!

I like the product and I think I notice it's been helping clear up my skin. However I can only use at night. I've used it multiple mornings and when I use this and then apply mineral powder foundation on top of it it is NOT good.

I am on my third bottle of this. I was trying all kinds of different products to clear up the acne I get in my hairline, eyebrows, and around my chin. I have senstive skin so trying new products is a very long (and expensive) process of trial and error. I ended up decided to cut back to just a face wash, moisterizer, and spf. My skin looked clearer than it ever had in over a decade using this. Just to be sure it was this product I subbed another moisterizer for a week and i started getting breakouts again. Went back to this and cleared it up quick. I will never be without this in my skincare routine. I slowly added back in various products like an acid in the morning and retinol at night and I can still tolerate using this everyday with other products. I only use this water gel in the morning. As long as i let it settle for a couple minutes, I have no issues with pilling with my SPF and makeup. Only downside is that i much prefer the previous packaging that had the pump.

avis.titre: Long time moisturizer for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I have tried countless moisturizers over the years, and I keep coming back to this one (3+ years). A family member of mine is an esthetician, so even after years of trying different high cost brand moisturizers, none work like this one. When I do try to switch, I break out due to my sensitive skin. I have super sensitive skin due to allergies, and I've struggled with acne for years. It will most likely be the only moisturizer I will use for the rest of my life. I'm bummed they don't sell it in stores anymore, so now I have to order online. Nevertheless, after many trials and errors of different products, I will forever be the poster child for this stuff.

avis.titre: I would buy this product forever
avis.texte: i can't think of a better acne-prone, oily skin moisturizer. This is the BEST one, hands down. This never makes me breakout and it's super hydrating. Sometimes gel textures tend to "pill," but this one doesn't. it feels like the most luxurious moisturizer I've ever used
